name: R.M.K. Engineering College
summary: R.M.K. Engineering College was started in 1995 by the Lakshmikanthammal Educational Trust at Kavaraipettai, Gummidipoondi taluk, about 30 km from Chennai. It is affiliated to Anna University, autonomous for 2020–21 to 2029–30, and accredited by NAAC with A+ (CGPA 3.52); all eligible UG programmes are NBA-accredited.
